subject.title: fix(ui): keep board fixture dropdowns legible across themes

question: Should the standalone board fixture retain its own early root-theme bootstrap, rather than absorb this theme boundary into the broader widget-presentation work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111977?
rationale: The patch is deliberately scoped around a shared fixture that another open PR also changes, so a human should confirm the intended ownership split before merging.

options.title: Keep the focused fixture fix
options.body: Accept the standalone document-level theme bootstrap and keep the broader widget-presentation PR independent.

options.title: Consolidate with the broader work
options.body: Move the fixture-theme responsibility into the adjacent presentation-contract PR if maintainers want one owner for all fixture presentation behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep the focused fixture fix
recommendation.body: Accept the standalone document-level theme bootstrap and keep the broader widget-presentation PR independent.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context identifies this contributor as the active author of both coordinated board-fixture changes, though repository-history ownership could not be fully verified here.
